import 'package:adele_contract/adele_contract.dart';
import 'package:adele_environment/adele_environment.dart';
import 'package:adele_plugin_backend_support/adele_plugin_backend_support.dart';

import 'prepared_capability_contract.dart';
import 'prepared_environment_capability_support.dart';

// B owns fixed semantic actions, not an executable/argument forwarding API.
// It has no filesystem, process, stock Git or internal host dependency.
Future<void> main(List<String> arguments, Object? bootstrapMessage) =>
    runProbeBackend(
      arguments,
      bootstrapMessage,
      (state) => {
        'callable-shared': {
          capabilityProbeServiceId: AdeleContextualServiceDispatcher(
            hostRequests: state.hostRequests,
            createDispatcher: (operation) => CapabilityProbeServiceDispatcher(
              _Probe(state, operation),
              concurrent: true,
            ),
          ),
        },
        'context-free': {
          capabilityProbeServiceId: CapabilityProbeServiceDispatcher(
            _Probe(state, null),
          ),
        },
      },
    );

final class _Probe implements CapabilityProbeService {
  const _Probe(this.state, this.operation);
  final ProbeState state;
  final AdeleBackendOperationContext? operation;

  @override
  Future<ProbeValue> read(String scope) async {
    if (operation == null) {
      throw StateError('Buffered process actions require an operation.');
    }
    final channel = operation!.bind(
      authorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceId,
    );
    final process = AuthorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceClient(channel);
    state.bufferedClients[scope] = process;
    try {
      await state.checkpoint('before:$scope');
      if (scope == 'read-service') {
        await AuthorizedEnvironmentReadServiceClient(
          operation!.bind(authorizedEnvironmentReadServiceId),
        ).readFile('A');
        throw StateError('Process grant unexpectedly included read.');
      }
      if (scope == 'foreign-id') {
        await channel.request(
          authorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceRunBufferedProcessId,
          {
            'environmentId': 'primary',
            'request': {
              'program': 'git',
              'arguments': ['ls-files', '-z'],
              'relativeWorkingDirectory': '',
              'timeoutSeconds': 5,
              'stdinBase64': '',
            },
          },
        );
        throw StateError('Foreign Environment payload unexpectedly admitted.');
      }
      final List<String> arguments;
      switch (scope) {
        case 'files':
          arguments = ['ls-files', '-z'];
        case 'stdout-overflow':
          arguments = ['show', ':overflow.bin'];
        case 'timeout':
          arguments = ['-c', 'alias.buffered-probe=!sleep 5', 'buffered-probe'];
        case 'empty':
          arguments = ['diff', '--quiet'];
        case 'nonzero':
          arguments = [
            'rev-parse',
            '--verify',
            'refs/heads/absent-buffered-probe',
          ];
        case 'hash':
        case 'held':
        case 'one':
        case 'two':
        case 'fresh':
        case 'stdin-bound':
        case 'unavailable':
          arguments = ['hash-object', '--stdin'];
        default:
          throw ArgumentError('Unknown semantic action.');
      }
      final input = scope == 'stdin-bound'
          ? List<int>.filled(environmentBufferedProcessStdinLimit, 255)
          : const [0, 255, 195, 40, 128, 97, 0];
      final result = await process.runBufferedProcess(
        EnvironmentBufferedProcessRequest(
          program: 'git',
          arguments: ['-c', 'adele.probeAction=$scope', ...arguments],
          relativeWorkingDirectory: '',
          timeoutSeconds: scope == 'timeout' ? 1 : 5,
          stdinBase64:
              scope == 'files' || scope == 'empty' || scope == 'nonzero'
              ? ''
              : encodeEnvironmentProcessBytes(
                  input,
                  maximumBytes: environmentBufferedProcessStdinLimit,
                ),
        ),
      );
      await state.checkpoint('after:$scope');
      return ProbeValue(
        provider: 'buffered',
        configuration: result.stdoutBase64,
        sequence: result.exitCode,
        text: result.stderrBase64,
      );
    } on EnvironmentFailure catch (error) {
      state.failures.add(error.code);
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      await state.checkpoint('settled:$scope');
    }
  }

  @override
  Stream<ProbeValue> watch(String scope) =>
      throw UnsupportedError('Unary semantic actions only.');
}
